title: Toast
description: toast() shows a short message after an action, with a tone and an optional action (Hoàn tác). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout.
when: Confirm an action happened (Đã lưu), warn about something passing (mất kết nối), offer undo.

instead.need: A message that must stay on the page

a11y: A live region (polite, assertive for danger); toasts with an action stay until dismissed or wait longer.
notes: <ToastHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); every toast() call anywhere shows there.
